splitPolicy: Candidate creators, source-evidenced aliases, creator accounts, derived shoot IDs, source URLs without query strings, titles, pageids, Commons SHA-1 values, and any existing historical SHA-256 values were checked against all six old captured manifests plus data/captured-val-m7/manifest.json. Veljo Runnel and Veljorunnel are reserved to validation and are excluded from confirmation.
identityPolicy: Every proposed clip has the current Commons SHA-1 plus SHA-256 of exactly the first 2,097,152 HTTP bytes of its current Commons source URL. These are identity pins for a proposed manifest only, not freeze claims.
licenseReviewGate: For uploader/credited-author mismatches or external third-party source URLs, a manual Commons LicenseReview record is required. Own-work uploads where the credited author and uploader are the same account do not require review. The source audit records template presence, pass state, reviewer, date, and caveats for every candidate.

unresolvedIssues.status: The raw page has a dated manual LicenseReview by INeverCry. Exact reviewer group membership on that historical date was not independently reconstructed; preserved for Main final review.
The raw Commons page declares Source own and labels its YouTube link a cross-upload; the linked platform record was not independently owned/attributed. Preserved for Main final review.
Commons metadata says 1000 fps; retained verbatim and not independently decoded.
All visual observations are limited to one official Commons poster per clip; no complete-video facts are inferred from posters.

checkedAndPassed: no normalized creator or alias overlaps any of the seven existing manifests
no stored or derived shootId overlaps
no source_url, title, pageid or commonsSha1 overlaps
every clip carries both a Commons SHA-1 and a 2 MiB prefix SHA-256
every clip carries a structured licenseReview record
notVerifiedByMain: the poster-frame observations, which are the research agent's inspection, not mine
that each licence-review template is genuinely from a trusted reviewer
anything about frames beyond the single Commons poster image per clip
independentVerificationByMain.knownGap: Seven of the project's eight content categories are represented. There are no `text` clips: urban 2, motion 3, lowlight 2, nature 3, faces 1, daylight 4, texture 1. The validation corpus carries all eight, so this proposal is not yet category-complete.
independentVerificationByMain.status: PROPOSED and unfrozen. No model has been scored against it and none may be until it is verified and frozen.
